summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, software engineer with a focus on web development, strong interest in programming languages (especially Go and Rust), advocates for open-source software and privacy rights, critical of corporate influence in politics, engaged in discussions about mental health and societal issues, values empirical evidence in debates, supports educational reform and access to quality education, skeptical of traditional political narratives, interested in the intersection of technology and social issues, has a nuanced understanding of economics and labor markets, likely to participate in tech-related communities and discussions on platforms like Hacker News and Reddit.
